sample_unit: chatbot answers (2 chatbots x 20 drugs x 4 questions x 3 repetitions)

links.outcome: Readability of chatbot answers on oral anticancer drugs (Flesch reading-ease score)
links.effect: Mean Flesch reading-ease scores were 38.8 (Copilot) and 50.9 (Gemini), indicating low readability.
links.quote: Both chatbots' answers demonstrated low readability according to the overall mean Flesch reading-ease scores of 38.8 (Copilot) and 50.9 (Gemini).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of commercial LLM chatbots (Copilot and Gemini) responding to patient queries about oral anticancer drugs, assessing readability, completeness, and accuracy without testing a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
